newsitem.title: USA: CME LUMBER ENDS DOWN SHARPLY ON WEAKER CASH IDEAS.
newsitem.headline: CME LUMBER ENDS DOWN SHARPLY ON WEAKER CASH IDEAS.

text.p: Long liquidation and some sell stops kept CME lumber futures down sharply into the close, traders said.
Lumber closed $9.20 to $2.10 per tbf lower with September off most at $352.30 and November off $5.60 at $348.00 per tbf.

Selling pressure increased on reports of continued adequate supplies of lumber available for purchase. Cash prices may have firmed this week but there has been plenty of wood for sale as production continues to exceed overall demand, traders said.
"Nobody had any problem finding prompt wood at a reasonable price even when things were busy," one cash source said.
